_README: TEMPLATE ONLY - contains no real index data and qualifies nothing.
Copy to sp500-announcements.json and fill it from OFFICIAL S&P DJI
Why manual: spglobal.com returns HTTP 403 to plain automated requests
(robots.txt included) - publisher bot protection. Circumventing it is not
permitted, so the owner supplies the official documents and this manifest
binds each one to a verified sha256 of the document file.
Hard rules enforced at load time (all fail closed):
* baseline.as_of MUST equal coverage.start - a later baseline would
* every announcement must fall inside the declared coverage window.
* source_document_checksum must be a real 64-hex sha256; when
document_path is set, the file digest is RECOMPUTED and must match.
* every added/removed ticker must map to a stable security_id.
Coverage is bounded on purpose. Declare the production window you actually
need via --production-start/--production-end: if the manifest is narrower,
the result is PARTIAL, never an overclaimed PASS.

baseline._note: Constituents as published AT the window start, from an official point-in-time document. Never today's list.
